port.comment: Loopback HTTP port for the Local Agent (1–65535). Match the port in Extension Settings. Restart the Agent after changing it.

workspacePath.comment: Local Workspace directory. Relative paths are resolved from the folder containing researchtube_agent.py; absolute paths select another location. On Windows use forward slashes (for example D:/ResearchTubeWorkspace) or escaped backslashes in JSON. Restart the Agent after changing this value. Existing files are not moved automatically.

visualMapTimestampFont.comment: Font filename from agent/tools/fonts used for timestamp overlays. Use a filename, not a host path.

mediaCaptureFrameMaxFrames.comment: Maximum requested frames in one media_capture_frame batch; default 20, range 1–100.

mediaClipMaxSegments.comment: Maximum requested intervals in one media_clip task; default 20, range 1–100. Omitting segments processes the whole source as one interval.

cameraRecordAudioMaxMinutes.comment: Maximum duration of one camera_record_audio recording, in minutes; default 10, range 1–1440.

cameraRecordVideoMaxMinutes.comment: Maximum duration of one camera_record_video recording, in minutes; default 1, range 1–1440.

libraryStoreMaxFiles.comment: Maximum Workspace files in one library_store_start batch; default 5, range 1–100.

libraryStoreMaxFileSizeMiB.comment: Maximum individual Library-upload file size in MiB (1048576 bytes). Larger files are skipped and reported; default 20, range 1–512.

mediaToChatMaxFiles.comment: Maximum Workspace files in one media_to_chat or Browser Agent resourceIds batch; default 5, range 1–100. Independent of the Library limit.

mediaToChatMaxFileSizeMiB.comment: Maximum individual current-chat upload size in MiB. Larger files are skipped and reported; default 20, range 1–512. Also bounds Browser Agent resource extraction, private byte ingestion and delivery to its dedicated chat.

completedTaskHistoryLimit.comment: Maximum retained completed/failed/cancelled records per task manager; default 2000, range 1–100000. Oldest terminal records are removed from memory and Extension task storage. Active/queued work and output files are never deleted. Timer records are also lost on Agent restart.

mediaWidgetHandshakeTimeoutSeconds.comment: Seconds allowed for an image, video or audio widget to connect to the Extension and load its local viewer. The widget retries connection every second. Default 10, range 1–300. Read for each media_show call; existing loading attempts keep their timeout. Retry starts a fresh attempt.

newToolsEnabledByDefault.comment: Default activation of automatically discovered custom tools without a saved individual preference. true enables those custom tools; false leaves them disabled. Newly introduced built-in ResearchTube tools are enabled independently of this setting. Existing individual tool choices are preserved. The Extension reads this from the Agent, using its last known value (initially true) if unavailable. Refresh the MCP schema after discovering custom tools.

composerMediaRetryCount.comment: Maximum repeated checks after the initial immediate check for Composer file acceptance, enabled Send and post-click submission acknowledgement. Default 15; integer 1–300. Files are inserted once. Enabled Send may be dispatched again while the same guarded payload remains unacknowledged; stop immediately when submission is confirmed. Cancellation/user-edit/target guards remain active before Send. Active ChatGPT generation has its separate existing response wait. Read for each attachment/send operation.

composerMediaRetryIntervalSeconds.comment: Seconds between Composer media checks. Default 2; integer 1–60. With 15 retries the normal budget is about 30 seconds plus operation latency. Successful acceptance/readiness/acknowledgement ends polling immediately; no fixed delay is imposed when ready. Applies to media_to_chat, artifact addToChat, Browser Agent resources and Library transfers.

browserStudyDetailedLogging.comment: Detailed Study this site timing diagnostics in the Extension service-worker console. Default true during optimization; set false for normal compact logs. Read once per new study session; existing sessions keep their setting. Logs stage durations, CDP method/count/duration summaries, node/byte counts and gaps between page tool calls; never page text, prompts, resource URLs, file paths or CDP bodies. Gaps include client/model/user waiting and are not pure model processing time.

browserStudyGroupTabs.comment: Group the two new Study this site tabs (site copy and dedicated ChatGPT conversation). Default true; false leaves them ungrouped. Uses a short RT · page title, or hostname when untitled. The source tab is untouched. Read on each new study session; groups already created are unchanged.

browserStudyMaxNodes.comment: Maximum nodes per Browser Agent observation or automatic post-action update. Default 200; integer 1–1000. The first read includes full-depth accessible content instead of a shallow outline. MCP maxNodes may reduce this ceiling, not raise it. Increase only if useful page content is being deferred. Read once per new study session.

browserStudyMaxChars.comment: Maximum serialized node payload characters per Browser Agent observation or automatic post-action update, including node IDs and structure. Default 48000; integer 1000–100000. Page metadata and bounded change summaries add small overhead. MCP maxChars may reduce this ceiling. Long text and omitted nodes remain available through pagination or site_get_text. Read once per new study session.

composerAutoSendTimeoutSeconds.comment: Idle Composer watchdog: auto-send unchanged nonempty text/attachments after this many seconds in a ResearchTube-used ChatGPT tab. Task completion notifications do not wait for this timeout when the Composer is empty. Range 1–3600.
